correctness.rationale: For fixed M, writing tau(n)=sum_{uv=n}1 and partitioning u modulo M gives each residue mass W_M(a)=M^(-2) sum_{u mod M} gcd(u,M)1_{gcd(u,M)|a}, positive and summing to 1. Squarefree primorial CRT gives local weights (p-1)/p² and (2p-1)/p². Remove the lower-weight endpoint of every circular forbidden edge 1<=d<=h to obtain an h-separated periodic independent set. Hellinger affinity factors H_p for p∤d; H_p=1-(3-2sqrt 2)/p+O(p^-2), so Mertens gives missing weight O_h((log Y)^-(3-2sqrt 2)). Every nontrivial periodic spacing pattern omits a positive-mass residue, proving no attainment. Independently verified exact CRT weights and circular independence for moduli 6,30,210; prime-product proof is analytic and not inferred from tests.
residual_risks: h fixed, period chosen prior to X→∞; no uniformity when period grows with X.
Convergence rate relies on Mertens prime-reciprocal theorem.
